runtime.title: Governance and execution proof
runtime.subtitle: Agent audit panel: gathers the proof of every governed execution, the automatic detections in documents, the registered executors, and the batch conflicts.

purpose.title: What this screen is for
purpose.body: This is where you inspect and prove what the agents did — not where content is created, but where it is audited and accepted. Each governed execution produces a reproducible proof (the "bundle": what was read, the model used, and the result). An automatic sweep flags sensitive or stale passages in documents. And you track which executors are registered and whether any batch had a conflict.
purpose.testHint: How to test: on Overview, check the four numbers and the GO/NO-GO technical signal; then open the "Execution proofs" tab and expand a proof to see the reproducible bundle and the turn metrics.

runtime.empty: No data published by the runtime.

summary.staleDetail: {{count}} passage(s) flagged by the sweep, not documents

tooltips.receipts: Reproducible record of each governed agent execution.
tooltips.findings: Automatic alerts per passage — not the count of documents.
tooltips.executors: Agent engines registered and ready to run.
tooltips.conflicts: Divergences within a batch; zero means consistent.

goNoGo.goBody: The API responds and the current proof batch reports no selection conflicts.
goNoGo.noGoBody: The API is unhealthy or a bundle conflict exists; investigate before acceptance.

executors.title: Executor catalog
executors.body: Availability and enablement reported by the runtime.

benchmark.title: Hashline benchmark
benchmark.body: Backend-published comparison for the protected editing strategy.

receipts.limitNote: The P1 API returns a batch of up to 100 receipts and does not publish a next-page cursor; the UI does not simulate pagination.
receipts.emptyBody: Run a real Bruna turn and try again. The acceptance profile does not inject test data.

documents.catalogUnavailableBody: The P1 OpenAPI does not expose the manifest or linter health. The list below only contains documents observed in real receipts, without fabricated owners, authority, or status.
documents.observedBody: Selection, checksum, and budget captured by receipts in the current batch.
documents.findingsBody: Runtime detections grouped by document; no action is performed automatically.
documents.noFindings: No finding published by the runtime.

evaluation.title: Clean-context evaluation
evaluation.body: Submits criteria, diff, and evidence to the independent read-only P1 evaluator. Do not include secrets or classified content.
evaluation.requiredError: Fill in the required identifiers, criteria, diff, and evidence.
evaluation.historyUnavailableBody: P1 only publishes POST /evaluations. The current result remains in the screen session; no list or replay endpoint exists.

hashline.title: Hashline-protected patch
hashline.body: The real write is rejected before changing the file when the checksum diverges. Use only after re-reading the target.
hashline.confirm: I confirm that I re-read the file, validated the relative path, and understand this action can write to the project.

learning.title: Governed P2 learning
learning.body: Manual, auditable lifecycle from canonical OpenAPI and event catalog 1.1.

learning.title: Learning candidates
learning.body: Paginated, tenant-scoped, governed queue. Promotion is never automatic.
learning.empty: No candidate matches the current filters.
learning.select: Select a candidate to inspect evidence, comparison, actions, and history.
learning.periodNote: The contract has no period query: dates filter loaded pages only; project, type, and state are server-side filters.
learning.independentEvaluator: The evaluator must differ from the actor and return pass for approval; the server enforces the authoritative policy.
learning.manualPromotion: I confirm this manual promotion after human review of evidence, independent evaluation, and shadow results.
learning.permissionDenied: Your profile is not authorized for this transition.
